<thought>We will search the template catalog for a retrosynthetic template that matches the carbonyl‑ene reaction. The forward reaction breaks a ketone (C=O) and a C‑C double bond, and forms a new C‑C bond and a C‑O bond (an aliphatic hydroxyl). Using the available functional group names, we set functional_groups_broken to ["ketones","C-C double bonds"], functional_groups_formed to ["aliphatic hydroxyls"], and specify the bond changes.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "C=C(c1ccccc1)C1CCCC1(OH)C(F)(F)F",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["ketones", "C-C double bonds"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["aliphatic hydroxyls"],
    "bonds_broken": ["C=O", "C=C"],
    "bonds_formed": ["C-C", "C-O"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
